spans.s: दुगूल n. (-लं) Wove silk: see the preceding.

दुग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
 1. Filled, full.
 2. Milked.
 n. (-ग्धं)
 1.

.
Milking f. (-ग्धी) A medicinal plant; also क्षीरी.
 E. दुह् to milk,
affix क्त ।

दुग्धकूपिका f. (-का) A sort of cake made of ground rice, and milk, &c.
fried with ghee.

दुग्धता f. (-ता) Milkiness, the nature of milk.
 E. तल् added to दुग्ध; also
with त्व दुग्धत्वम् ।

दुग्धतालीय n. (-यं) Milk and mangoes, mango fool.
 2. The froth of
[]
milk, syllabub.
 3. The skim of milk or cream.
 E. दुग्धता, लीङ् to
embrace or adhere, affix छ ।

दुग्धपाचन n. (-नं) A vessel for boiling milk.
 E. दुग्ध milk, and पाचन
cooking

दुग्धपुच्छी f. (-च्छी) A plant commonly Dugdhapeya.
 E. दुग्ध milk, and
पुच्छ a tail.

दुग्धफेन n. (-नं) The froth or skim of milk, syllabub, cream.
 f. (-नी) A
small medicinal shrub, so called.
 E. दुग्ध milk, फेन froth, foam.

दुग्धाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A sort of stone, (opal.)
 E. दुग्ध milk, and अक्ष a die, &c.

दुग्धाब्धि m. (-ब्धिः) The sea of milk.
 E. दुग्ध, and अब्धि sea.

दुग्धाब्धितनया f. (-या) A name of LAKṢMĪ.
 E. दुग्धाब्धि, and तनया daughter.

दुग्धिका f. (-का) A sort of Asclepias, (A rosea, Rox.) the Hindi deri-
vative Dudhi, is also applied to Euphorbia hirta and thymifolia.
E. दुग्ध milk, and ठन् affix, and the feminine form; the leaves, &c.
yielding a milky sap.

दुग्धिन् mfn. (-ग्धी-ग्धिनी-ग्धि) Milky, having milk.
 E. दुग्ध, and इनि aff.

दुग्धिनिका f. (-का) A plant described as a red sort of Apang, (Achyranthes
aspera.)
